metadata.title: Mid-Century Celestial Portrait Album Cover
useCases: Retro religious or choral music packaging

recipe.visualDefinition: A painterly male portrait set against a textured, deep blue celestial background filled with scattered white stars. The style features visible, expressive brushstrokes and a warm, skin-toned palette for the subject, contrasted against a cool, atmospheric night sky. The layout is top-heavy with centered, multi-layered typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm flesh tones against cool indigo and teal background
Textured impasto-style portraiture against a flat, graphic text block
Subject's gaze directed slightly off-camera to create a contemplative mood
Horizontal rule lines separating title, artist, and tracklist
coreInvariants: High-contrast yellow and white typography at the top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the lower two-thirds, slightly left of center, shown from the chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, rendered with the most detail and warmest colors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold yellow title, moves down to the white artist name, then follows the subject's gaze toward the right side of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third and the right side are dominated by the dark, starry sky, providing space for text and atmosphere.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo and teal blue (background sky)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Peach and pink (subject's skin and shirt highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white stars/text and the dark background; high saturation in the yellow title.

letterConstructionRules: Open counters in the display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Slightly flared terminals on the display serif
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold yellow all-caps serif for impact paired with a softer white title-case serif for elegance.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the flared, sharp serif quality of the main title.
Provides the classic, readable serif look for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an oil painting of a middle-aged man with short dark hair, wearing a black suit and light pink shirt. Use visible, textured brushstrokes. The background is a dark teal and indigo night sky with scattered, glowing white stars. Leave the top third of the image relatively clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered text in the top third. The main title should be in a bold, yellow, all-caps serif font. Below it, add a subtitle in a medium-weight, white, title-case serif font. Place thin horizontal lines above and below the subtitle.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait painterly with visible texture?
Is the main title bright yellow and all-caps?
Are the stars scattered naturally across the dark blue sky?
Is the composition centered and top-heavy with text?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the yellow title
mustRedesign: Any specific corporate logos in the corners
The exact facial features of the original artist
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no modern sans-serif fonts are used.
Check that the paint texture doesn't obscure the legibility of the text.
Verify the color contrast between the yellow text and blue background is high.
Confirm the subject's lighting matches the warm tones of the skin.
recipe.reuseFormula: Painterly Portrait + Celestial Background + Tiered Serif Typography (Yellow/White) = Mid-Century Album Aesthetic
